|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “Cancel one attempt by opponent to 'react' away from a battle. OR Cancel Dodge. OR ▲ Ice Storm, He Hasn't Come Back Yet, or Cold Feet. OR Cancel opponent's attempt to randomly remove one or more cards from your hand (except with Grimtaash).”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Stop Motion (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Take Cold Feet, He Hasn’t Come Back Yet, or Ice Storm into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Cancel Dodge. OR Cancel opponent’s ‘react’ away from battle. OR Cancel opponent’s attempt to randomly remove one or more cards from your hand (except with Grimtaash).” '''What changed:''' “Cancel one attempt by opponent to 'react' away” → “Take Cold Feet, He Hasn’t Come Back Yet, or Ice Storm into hand”; “a battle.” → “Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”; “▲ Ice Storm, He Hasn't Come Back Yet, or Cold Feet.” → “Cancel opponent’s ‘react’ away from battle.”; “opponent's” → “opponent’s”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=5 VirtualCards4.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown); page 5, slip 49*. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Stop Motion]].
* Later text: [[Stop Motion (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
